# scm_cngfw_ngfirewall (Resource)

NgfirewallCreateRequest resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scm_cngfw_ngfirewall" "example" {
  region                = "us-east-1"
  description           = "Sample CNGFW firewall managed by Terraform"
  customer_zone_id_list = ["use1-az1", "use1-az2"]
  tier                  = "standard"
  scm_labels            = ["sample-dev", "sample-prod"]
  mode                  = "CNGFW"
  tags = [
    {
      key   = "FirewallName"
      value = "sample-terraform-cngfw"
    },
    {
      key   = "CreatedBy"
      value = "Sample Terraform CNGFW"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `customer_zone_id_list` (List of String) List of customer-defined security zone IDs. Required.
- `region` (String) The AWS region where the Cloud NGFW firewall is deployed

### Optional

- `allow_list_accounts` (List of String) AWS account IDs permitted to access the firewall endpoint service.
- `change_protection` (List of String) List of attributes protected from change.
- `description` (String) A human-readable description of the firewall.
- `egress_nat` (Attributes) Egress NAT configuration for outbound traffic. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--egress_nat))
- `endpoints` (Attributes List) Firewall endpoint configurations. Assigned by the service when the firewall is created; can be changed with an update. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints))
- `gwlb_tcp_idle_timeout` (Number) GWLB TCP idle timeout in seconds. Defaults to 350; can be changed with an update.
- `link_id` (String) The link ID to associate with the firewall.
- `mode` (String) The operational mode of the firewall. Set when the firewall is created and cannot be changed afterward. Possible values are `CNGFW`.
- `private_access` (Attributes) Private access configuration for the firewall. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--private_access))
- `scm_labels` (List of String) Strata Cloud Manager (SCM) labels to apply to the firewall.
- `source` (String) The source SDK or provider that created the firewall. Automatically set by the SDK or Terraform provider; do not set this field manually. Possible values are `SCM-SDK` and `Terraform-Provider-SCM`.
- `tags` (Attributes List) AWS resource tags to apply to the firewall. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `tier` (String) The service tier for the firewall, either standard or premium. Possible values are `standard` and `premium`.
- `user_id` (Attributes) User-ID configuration for user-based policy enforcement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_id))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the Cloud NGFW firewall.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
